name: street-fighter
theme: the street gangs of a near-future city at night, the figure shown alone on a plain light grey studio backdrop, no street, no rain, no signs, no scenery
description: A bare-knuckle street fighter, a lean, muscular man in his thirties with a shaved head and a short dark beard, wearing a dark charcoal hooded rain jacket of waxed cotton left open over a faded grey cotton vest, grimy cloth tape wrapped round his knuckles and wrists, black canvas cargo trousers with worn knee patches, and scuffed black leather work boots; the jacket creased and worn
